lines.text: L-I-V-E。活着！不然更衣室里你就没什么好吹的。
lines.en: L-I-V-E. Live! Otherwise, you've got nothing to talk about in the locker room.
lines.note: 莫德劝哈罗德抓住生命时的对白；Wikiquote／IMDb quotes／片中字幕可核。

lines.text: 很多人享受着「死了」的状态——但其实他们没死，只是在回避生活。伸出手去，试试看，哪怕受伤。
lines.en: A lot of people enjoy being dead. But they are not dead, really. They're just backing away from life. Reach out. Take a chance. Get hurt even.
lines.note: 莫德的生命观（节选）；IMDb quotes 可查。
